facts.fact: The Lesotho Communications Authority says it held two rounds of public consultation on its revised licensing framework for low-orbit satellite services, the second concluded 20 March 2025, and met commenters in person.

LSO.note: Report went to the Board; the notice does not say it was published.

facts.fact: The LCA Board resolved to grant Starlink Lesotho a ten-year licence to run a satellite network and provide satellite internet, with terms still to be finalised.
